verdict.rationale: The only concrete multi-item operation in the evidence is the Local Search POI and descriptions endpoints, whose `ids` parameter accepts up to 20 location IDs in one request. The Answers service is also said to ground on multiple searches. There is no general batch endpoint for running many web, news or image queries at once; pagination is per-request only. Missing for 10: a batch or bulk query endpoint across search types, documented limits and throughput for bulk jobs, async or bulk job handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
